author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಕಣ್ಣೆದುರು ಕಾಣುವುದು ನಿಜವೆಂಬುದೇನಿಲ್ಲ
ತಣ್ಣನೆಯೆ ಯೋಚಿಸಲು ತಿಳಿಯುವುದು ಸತ್ಯ
ಬಣ್ಣವನು ಕಳಚುತಲೆ ನಿಜಬಣ್ಣವರಿಯುತಿರೆ
ಸಣ್ಣತನ ತೊರೆದುನಡೆ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: What you see before your eyes is not necessarily true;
truth is known when you think it through calmly;
as you strip off the paint and come to know the real colour,
walk on, leaving pettiness behind, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Appearances deceive. Truth emerges from calm reflection. As we learn to see past the surface, we should also let go of small-mindedness.
